name: Abdou Yaackoubi
title: Senior Product Designer
tagline: I love working in the realm between UX and UI design.
intro: Things that make me excited are user-centred design, interaction design, and making interfaces feel fun and human.
currently: Senior product designer at InstaDeep, working on DeepPCB.
contactLede: Senior product designer at InstaDeep. Open to conversations about product design work.
about: I entered the UX/UI design field on 1 January 2020. Since then I have worked with eight startups across fintech, food delivery, online courses, automotive, pharmacy and development.

From October 2021 to November 2023 I was Chief Product Officer at Steer, leading a small team of front-end and back-end engineers while being the only person in design and product. The company went on to raise in France and is now based in Versailles.
I am now a senior product designer at InstaDeep, working on DeepPCB — their AI-powered, cloud-native PCB routing software.
Outside of work I am obsessed with video games and enjoy the gym, and I cherish time with family and friends.
